description: This file defines a data structure for talk provider configuration, along with functions for parsing and resolving configuration data from dictionaries, including fallback mechanisms and normalization.

methods.name: bridgeFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Converts a Foundation Dictionary to a dictionary with AnyCodable values.

methods.name: selectProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects a provider configuration from a talk dictionary, with fallback options, normalization, and validation.

methods.name: resolvedPositiveInt
methods.description: Resolves an AnyCodable value into a positive integer, with a fallback.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Gets the silence timeout in milliseconds, resolving from talk dictionary with fallback.

methods.name: normalizedTalkProviderID
methods.description: Normalizes a provider ID string by trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolvedProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves a provider configuration from talk dictionary if 'resolved' field is present.
